name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.62 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
